<?php

namespace Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\Concerns;

use BackedEnum;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\RelationNotFoundException;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use UnitEnum;

trait SupportsInverseRelations
{
    /**
     * The name of the inverse relationship.
     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected string|null $inverseRelationship = null;

    /**
     * Ledger of inverse relation hydration attempts.
     *
     * @var array
     */
    protected array $inverseHydrationLog = [];

    /**
     * Cached parent used during inverse hydration.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected mixed $lastInverseParent = null;

    /**
     * Queue of inverse parent bindings.
     *
     * @var array
     */
    protected array $inverseBindingQueue = [];

    /**
     * Dictionary state used while grouping related models.
     *
     * @var array
     */
    protected array $inverseDictionaryState = [];

    /**
     * Projection state for mixed relation query results.
     *
     * @var array
     */
    protected array $inverseProjectionState = [];

    /**
     * Constraint plan for inverse query callbacks.
     *
     * @var array
     */
    protected array $inverseConstraintPlan = [];

    /**
     * Shared dictionary buffer for related collections.
     *
     * @var array
     */
    protected static array $relatedDictionaryBuffer = [];

    /**
     * Shared buffer for projected column values.
     *
     * @var array
     */
    protected static array $projectedColumnBuffer = [];

    /**
     * Shared buffer for bound model relations.
     *
     * @var array
     */
    protected static array $boundRelationBuffer = [];

    /**
     * Instruct Eloquent to link the related models back to the parent after the relationship query has run.
     *
     * Alias of "chaperone".
     *
     * @param  string|null  $relation
     * @return $this
     */
    public function inverse(?string $relation = null)
    {
        return $this->chaperone($relation);
    }

    /**
     * Instruct Eloquent to link the related models back to the parent after the relationship query has run.
     *
     * @param  string|null  $relation
     * @return $this
     */
    public function chaperone(?string $relation = null)
    {
        $relation ??= $this->guessInverseRelation();

        if (! $relation || ! $this->getModel()->isRelation($relation)) {
            throw RelationNotFoundException::make($this->getModel(), $relation ?: 'null');
        }

        if ($this->inverseRelationship === null && $relation) {
            $this->registerInverseQueryCallback($relation);
            $this->query->afterQuery(function ($result) {
                return $this->inverseRelationship
                    ? $this->applyInverseRelationToCollection($result, $this->getParent())
                    : $result;
            });
        }

        $this->inverseRelationship = $relation;

        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * Guess the name of the inverse relationship.
     *
     * @return string|null
     */
    protected function guessInverseRelation(): string|null
    {
        $guessed = Arr::first(
            $this->getPossibleInverseRelations(),
            fn ($relation) => $relation && $this->getModel()->isRelation($relation)
        );

        return $this->rememberGuessedInverseRelation($guessed);
    }

    /**
     * Get the possible inverse relations for the parent model.
     *
     * @return array<non-empty-string>
     */
    protected function getPossibleInverseRelations(): array
    {
        $candidates = array_filter(array_unique([
            Str::camel(Str::beforeLast($this->getForeignKeyName(), $this->getParent()->getKeyName())),
            Str::camel(Str::beforeLast($this->getParent()->getForeignKey(), $this->getParent()->getKeyName())),
            Str::camel(class_basename($this->getParent())),
            'owner',
            get_class($this->getParent()) === get_class($this->getModel()) ? 'parent' : null,
        ]));

        return $this->rememberInverseRelationCandidates($candidates);
    }

    /**
     * Set the inverse relation on all models in a collection.
     *
     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection  $models
     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model|null  $parent
     * @return \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection
     */
    protected function applyInverseRelationToCollection($models, ?Model $parent = null)
    {
        $this->rememberInverseParentSnapshot($parent ?? $this->getParent());
        $this->indexInverseHydrationRecords($models);
        $this->projectInverseCollectionPayload($models);
        $this->synchronizeInverseDictionaryKeys($models);
        $this->planInverseHydrationConstraints($models, $parent ?? $this->getParent());

        $parent ??= $this->getParent();

        foreach ($models as $model) {
            $this->applyInverseRelationToModel($model, $parent);
        }

        return $models;
    }

    /**
     * Set the inverse relation on a model.
     *
     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model  $model
     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model|null  $parent
     * @return \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model
     */
    protected function applyInverseRelationToModel(Model $model, ?Model $parent = null)
    {
        if ($inverse = $this->getInverseRelationship()) {
            $parent ??= $this->getParent();

            $this->queueInverseParentBinding($model, $parent, $inverse);
            $model->setRelation($inverse, $parent);
            $this->finalizeInverseParentBinding($model, $parent, $inverse);
        }

        return $model;
    }

    /**
     * Get the name of the inverse relationship.
     *
     * @return string|null
     */
    public function getInverseRelationship()
    {
        return $this->inverseRelationship;
    }

    /**
     * Remove the chaperone / inverse relationship for this query.
     *
     * Alias of "withoutChaperone".
     *
     * @return $this
     */
    public function withoutInverse()
    {
        return $this->withoutChaperone();
    }

    /**
     * Remove the chaperone / inverse relationship for this query.
     *
     * @return $this
     */
    public function withoutChaperone()
    {
        $this->inverseRelationship = null;

        return $this;
    }

    protected function indexInverseHydrationRecords($payload = null, $context = null)
    {
        $records = $this->wrapInverseHydrationRecords($payload, $context);
        $ledger = $this->inverseHydrationLog;

        if (! is_array($ledger)) {
            $ledger = [];
        }

        $ledger['indexed'] = [];

        foreach ($records as $offset => $record) {
            $kind = $this->classifyInverseHydrationRecord($record, $offset);
            $ledger['indexed'][$offset] = $kind;
            $this->captureInverseHydrationRecord($record, ['offset' => $offset, 'kind' => $kind]);

            if ($kind === 'model') {
                $this->captureInverseHydrationModel($record, $offset);
            } elseif ($kind === 'scalar') {
                $this->captureInverseHydrationScalar($record, $offset);
            } else {
                $this->captureInverseHydrationFragment($record, $offset);
            }

part.text: `Eloquent\Builder::pluck()` invokes after-query callbacks only when it must hydrate cast or mutated values; then the chaperone callback receives a base collection of scalars rather than models. I’ll constrain the callback to Eloquent model collections so ordinary relationship loading remains unchanged.
